first_tcp_failure.cause: Game sends Ping before TCP handshake completes. SetupConnect is called but TryToConnect never executes before the Ping is posted. This is a RACE CONDITION in the game's TCP client initialization.
evidence: Run A line 108530: SetupConnect, then immediately line 108531: Failed to post Ping
Run B line 108029: SetupConnect, then immediately line 108030: Failed to post Ping
No TryToConnect between SetupConnect and failure in either run

bGameConnect_never_one.cause: After the first TCP failure sets bGameConnect=0, subsequent successful TCP connections never restore it to 1. The 'WebServer Revived' event fires but bGameConnect remains 0. This appears to be a game-level state machine bug where the GameConnect flag is only set during the initial connection, not during reconnection.
evidence: Run A line 109047: OnReceivePong / bGameConnect[0] (after successful TCP)
Run B line 108796: OnReceivePong / bGameConnect[0] (after successful TCP)

tcp_server_console_discrepancy.cause: UNKNOWN - The game log shows TCP connections in Run B, but the TCP server console showed zero connections. Possible explanations: (1) game connected to a stale TCP server from a previous run, (2) TCP server was started after game connection attempts, (3) game connected to a different process on port 6666.
evidence: Run B game log line 108790: Success to connect. GetTargetAddress[127.0.0.1:6666]
Run B game log line 108792: TryToSend / Send [17] Bytes
Run B game log line 108793: TryToReceive / Received
Run B game log line 108794: OnDecode_Ping: PingId:1
Run B game log line 108795: OnReceivePong / WebServer Revived!
TCP server console: ZERO connections observed

rendering_crash.cause: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION reading address 0x00000000 in FRCPassPostProcessAA::Process() at postprocessaa.cpp:289. This is a null pointer dereference in the rendering thread's post-processing anti-aliasing pass. Not related to networking.
evidence: Run A line 112089: FRCPassPostProcessAA::Process() at postprocessaa.cpp:289
